name: The McBirney household at 1736 Prairie Avenue
head: pa1904_mcbirney_hugh

present_on_scene_date.note: Listed at 1736 Prairie Avenue in the Blue Book for 1904 (canvass begun September 1903) and again in the 1905 edition (canvass begun September 1904), which bracket 1 July 1904. The 1905 list prints: 1736 Mr. & Mrs. Hugh McBirney; Day McBirney.

associated_with.note: The Blue Book's Prairie Avenue street list prints the household at 1736, and the 1905 list again. The book gives no date the household came or went, so neither end is dated here.

not_in_this_household.note: WHO IS NOT ON THIS CARD, AND WHY. The Blue Book is a society register: it names the family members who received and were received, prints unmarried daughters only as '& dr.', and names no young children, servants, coachmen, cooks or nurses. The 1900 census (ED 40, T623 roll 245) was read for this card. The three live-in staff it lists at the house on 1 June 1900 are on the card, graded inferred because the count was taken four years before the scene. A coachman's wife and children in the rear building are named in his note rather than carded. Left off: Marie S. Johnson (a sister-in-law of 67, the given name hard to read; no 1904 source puts her here); J. P. Mackenzie (a widowed sister-in-law; no 1904 source puts her here). The 1910 census was not read. A person goes on this card when a source names them, and not before.

persons.name: Hugh McBirney
persons.note: The 1900 census lists Hugh McBirney here as head, born February 1824, in Ireland, came to the United States in 1844, married, wholesale crockery (ED 40, sheet 1B, line 61, leaf n795).

persons.name: Mrs. Hugh McBirney
persons.note: The 1900 census lists Isabella M. McBirney here as wife, born October 1830 (the figures are hard to read), in Maryland, married (ED 40, sheet 1B, line 62, leaf n795).

persons.name: Day McBirney
persons.note: First listed at 1736 in the 1905 edition (canvass begun September 1904); not in the 1904 edition, so whether he was already here on 1 July 1904 is not documented. A relative by the surname; the relation is not printed.

persons.name: Minnie Corkin

born.note: The census gives January 1870, age 30 on 1 June 1900.

occupation.note: Written as "House maid" in the occupation column on 1 June 1900.

persons.note: Enumerated on 1 June 1900 in the house, as a servant (house maid); born January 1870, in Ireland, came to the United States in 1880, single. Servants changed places often, so this records who worked here in 1900; no source read says whether this person was still here on 1 July 1904. Part of the name is hard to read on the sheet; this is the best reading.

persons.note: Enumerated on 1 June 1900 in the rear building behind the house, as the head of his own household there (coachman); born January 1850, in Sweden, came to the United States in 1873, married. Living with him: Annie Young (wife). Servants changed places often, so this records who worked here in 1900; no source read says whether this person was still here on 1 July 1904.
